g.text: First 1 s of csChrimson stimulation. Each colored dot is one fly's mean across 80 pulses.
Turn direction varies between individual VES041 flies
Negative = left; positive = right, following the lab analysis-code convention.
Black diamonds: genotype means with 95% bootstrap intervals across flies.
Pooled 34 flies: mean -1.36 deg, 95% CI -7.92 to 5.36 deg; two-sided sign-flip p = 0.696.
